I told this on tales of fat hate from reddit, I believe, but it's time to renew an old, painful memory.

For about a year and a half I had been flirting with what I believed to be a nice lady. In my young, smitten love, I thought she had a gorgeous voice and in my fantasies she had the physicality to match. She was flirting back, of course. No homo, just two women madly in love, ready to spend our lives together.

Or so I thought.

I flew halfway across my country to go visit her one month, which is where everything went to shit. She had sent me photos before, but either just of her face or shoulders up- I never realized how sneaky this was, until, you know. I had known her for so long, so of course I could trust her, right?

There were a few red flags, in retrospect.

She said she didn't like how my tumblr kept a lot of images of beautiful thin models, and how she will never look like that! I disregarded it because who isn't self-conscious? She didn't have that great of a face, either, so of course she would feel insecure, right?

She supported body-positive garbage on tumblr. I disregarded it because it was tumblr, she surely was just into being the fashionable cool feminist, right? Even if I thought body positivity was supporting obesity and simultaneously bashing women in shape, it surely was just another tumblr bullshit thing, like all the generic SJW content or Dr Who/otherkin/etc fandom nonsense. Right?

One thing was how she talked about how difficult it was for her to find clothes. I actually briefly woke out of my dream and recognized this as being a problem, but when I asked her why she told me that she was tall- 5'10" or 5'11", how she would wear heels sometimes and be well over 6' tall. Understandable, right? It must be hard to find clothing when you're that tall.

We talked about fitness a lot, since it's quite important to me. She would text me on her phone while she was (allegedly) at the gym, talking about how worn out she gets doing cardio every day but she's still back there because she loves it, and I would text her when I was (actually) at the gym. We would talk about our diets and how healthy we ate, because she (allegedly) was eating mostly salads while I was (actually) on keto, finishing up a cut.

So the time came, and I flew halfway across the country, excited and ready to meet my tall, buff, Amazonian goddess.

She was maybe 5'7", 5'8" at the max, barely taller than I. Sure, from the shoulders up she looked normal... and then she turned into a complete diamond shape, with what looked like a monster truck tire around her waist.

Well..... shit. I didn't recognize her at all, despite her being one of the only people standing around at the airport. Her giant mass was clear and glaring, but I glanced over her and then turned my face away, scanning desperately.

That's why she couldn't find clothing, not because she was tall, but because she was an inhuman shape. That's why she only sent me pics of the shoulders up, because her waist was the size of Kansas. That's why she didn't like my cute frail femmes and buff bois on my tumblr, not because she was trying to be a stereotypical SJW, but because she could fit 3 normal sized people in her.

Regardless, my plane tickets were for the whole week, and her place was where I was staying, and I had no extra money for a hotel.

I toughed it out. It was still rough.

She ate constantly. We still hung out, but it was never for a long period at a time, because she would have to stop doing whatever to eat food every 30-60 mins. There was not a single salad in sight, either; she loved fast food, if she got coffee it would be laced with sugar, syrup, and cream. And I can put back fast food, for sure!- but not eat again an hour later, and then again and again multiple huge meals in the day. I couldn't even try to keep up with her for the sake of being nice.

She couldn't walk much at all. We would get out of her car to see some landmark or local spot of interest, and typically I would run ahead, double back, walk with her for a bit, run ahead some more, double back. My excuse was that I was just excited to see everything, her excuse would be that she didn't sleep much the night before. In any event, I ran around like a 5 year old child, while she breathed heavy and panted under the strain of fuckin walking.

We went to see a national park in her state which was absolutely incredible; I'd never seen mountains before, and it was the first time I'd seen snow in 10 years, so I was quite excited. She spent maybe 20 minutes walking very, very, slowly, before saying that she was tired, and so we had to leave. I never got the chance to truly see it. We spent maybe 3 hours in the car to get there, too.

She had a separate mattress for me to sleep on, thank you lord jesus, but she still woke me up in the middle of the night with the sound of her eating. There was one time we got Chinese during the day and I couldn't finish it, of course ("damn I'm so full!"), and she pretended to be full as well, although she ate snacks when we got home; later that evening I went to go to sleep and she said she had to take care of some stuff- as soon as she glanced back and thought my eyes were closed and I was asleep, she went to the kitchen to get the rest of her food and eat it, and she ate mine too.

At the end of the week I came back home, showered extra, and vowed to never meet another person again until I got full body pictures... and go back to that park when it snows with somebody in shape!
